about: The Characters roster check (RUST-DEPRECATE-01, GM 2026-10-20: Python is the sole rules authority). Each case starts from an empty roster; a step sends one request and expects ok, the error text, and (when given) the saved ids in order. The reference is sim/character_roster.py; the same cases run in the browser against the deprecated Rust engine (isles-table catalog_tests.mjs) to prove the two agree before Rust is archived. Artwork ids come from the creature manifest (spy: 1 square; adult_red_dragon: 3 squares).
